title: IDOL Prompt Packets v1.3 Legacy
description: Legacy 02B storyboard/review-board contract kept for archived LOW packets and diagnostic validation only. It is evidence-only and cannot open active execution; active 02B uses schemas/prompt-packets.schema.json v2.2 with one packet per Branch Cut.

title_catalog.description: Stable album/title registry. 02B source files stay in the run folder, but exports, manifests, generated boards, video prompts, videos, edits, and package outputs must be registered here so multi-day track work does not scatter by date.

identity_reference_rule.description: Face identity rule for API submission. Internal member codes must be paired with display names in source prompts, and export manifests must map attached face crops by API image input order, e.g. attached face reference image #1 = M03 Yeul.

pre_api_wrapper_contract.description: Non-creative render wrapper applied only during 02B export/preflight before paid API submission. These fields do not belong inside prompt_packets[].visual_layout_lock.per_cut_framing.

required_render_wrapper_fields.description: Fields that each export manifest render_wrapper must carry before API submission.

required_visible_label_fields.description: Visible label values that the top-left render wrapper must carry.

fixed_coordinate_regions.description: Stable percent-based canvas regions used by the export render_wrapper.

api_prompt_order.description: Order used when building the final API prompt from the wrapper and core prompt.

title_output_registry_path.description: Optional in authoring drafts, required by preflight/export manifests before paid API submission.

title_output_root.description: Stable album/title root for cross-day lookup; concrete generated files may remain run-owned.

validation_required_before_generation.description: 02B packets must always require validation before any paid generation route can be used.

camera_treatment.description: Non-layout creative camera treatment for the active beat keyframe: the camera evidence, angle, shot scale, movement, or composition pressure that makes the action readable. It should derive from 02A visual_frame.camera_treatment.

full_prompt_text.description: Compact core director prompt compiled from 02A/02B creative locks only. Keep only identity rule, scene intent, visual evidence, visible beat response, and avoid terms. Layout wrapper, top header, right reference strip, contact-sheet labels, internal packet/beat ids, raw timecodes, local paths, schema labels, validator notes, and operational gates must stay outside this field.

founderDirectorReviewSummary.description: Founder-facing director summary compiled from the final 02B prompt, shown before paid image generation so the founder reviews scene intent instead of raw prompt prose.

directorChain.description: Canonical director chain carried from selected audio through 01, 02A, and 02B: time -> lyric role -> music function/onset/tempo -> visible action -> must-show body/camera evidence -> space/wardrobe/background/edit handoff -> director treatment. Use this instead of separate cue, compact scene, or section director chains.

source_ref.description: Optional upstream section, timestamp, or artifact reference used to trace this director chain.

time_range.description: Exact audio window or section span. This is the timing anchor, not a final edit-cut id.

lyric_role.description: What the lyric or section means in the story/emotion flow.

music_function.description: What the music is doing structurally, such as intro signal, lift, drop, hook release, reset, or bridge pull.

onset_hit.description: The audible trigger that should create a visible hit, accent, transition, or camera response.

tempo_pulse.description: Speed, density, groove pressure, or beat-feel that should shape body/camera intensity.

emotion_or_atmosphere.description: Dominant feeling or atmosphere to preserve while directing the action.

member_blocking.description: Who is placed where and how the focus moves between member, unit, or group.

visible_action.description: Single primary observable event: dance phrase, body motion, gaze, hand/foot action, spatial move, or object/memory action.

must_show.description: Evidence checklist that proves the visible_action on screen. Do not use as a second action summary.

body.description: Body, face, hands, feet, gaze, formation, or spacing details that must be readable as evidence.

camera.description: Framing, angle, distance, lens movement, or cut evidence needed to make the action readable.

space_or_object.description: Where the action happens or which object anchors the action.

wardrobe_motion.description: Wardrobe/material motion only when it affects readability or emotion.

background_or_object_reaction.description: How the world, background, prop, light, or object responds to the audio/action.

edit_trigger.description: Audio or visual reason the next beat, panel, or cut should happen.

director_treatment.description: Integrated direction sentence combining emotion, action, visual evidence, and handoff without re-listing every field.
